# Coding Guidelines

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### 1. Fork isolation via grafts

Fork code lives in `app/src/main/java/app/olauncher/fork/`; shared files get single-line `FORK:<feature>` markers (`docs/fork/FORK_INTEGRATION.md`).

### 2. Pure-Kotlin policy objects

Decision logic is Android-free objects so JVM tests cover it: `ForkSwipePolicy`, `WorkspacePagerPolicy`, `BentoGridLayoutPlanner`, `ForkWidgetEntryJson` (hand-rolled JSON, no `org.json`). Tests in `app/src/test/java/app/olauncher/fork/`.

### 3. SharedPreferences property delegates

`Prefs` exposes typed `var` with `prefs.edit { ... }`; fork keys prefixed `FORK_` in `ForkWidgetPrefs`.

### 4. LiveData + viewModelScope

`MainViewModel` exposes `MutableLiveData` (e.g. `privateSpaceApps`); coroutines via `viewModelScope`; `CoroutineWorker` for background.

### 5. Style and lint

`kotlin.code.style=official` (`gradle.properties`); Android Lint with `app/lint-baseline.xml`, run in `build.yml`. No ktlint/detekt.
